edges.reason: transfer forwards to the internal _transfer.
transferFrom calls _transfer after allowance handling.
_transfer delegates final accounting to _tokenTransfer.
_tokenTransfer branch for standard transfers.
_tokenTransfer branch for transfers to excluded accounts.
_tokenTransfer branch for transfers from excluded accounts.
_tokenTransfer branch when both accounts are excluded.
_transfer triggers swapTokens which performs external calls before state settlement completes.
_transfer triggers buyBackTokens which performs external swaps and ETH sends.
swapTokens swaps the contract token balance for ETH.
swapTokens sends ETH to the marketing address after the swap.
buyBackTokens performs an ETH to token swap.
swapTokensForEth invokes the external router swap.
swapETHForTokens invokes the external payable router swap.
addLiquidity invokes router addLiquidityETH with ETH value.
transferToAddressETH executes a raw ETH transfer to a caller-influenced recipient.
Sweep drains the contract balance to the owner via transfer.
transferForeignToken moves arbitrary tokens to an owner-chosen address.
changeRouterVersion calls factory/pair creation with an owner-supplied router.
changeRouterVersion rewrites the stored uniswap pair.
_transferStandard derives amounts from _getValues.
_transferStandard forwards liquidity to _takeLiquidity.
_transferStandard reflects the fee via _reflectFee.
_getValues uses the integer rate from _getRate making results prone to rounding to zero.
_getRate obtains supplies from _getCurrentSupply.
_getCurrentSupply returns supply pair used by the rate computation.
_takeLiquidity credits reflection balance to the contract.
_reflectFee decreases the total reflection supply.
_removeOldSellHistories mutates the sell histories array.
transfer sender is msg.sender.

unlock authorizes solely by comparing _previousOwner to msg.sender.
transferOwnership is guarded by owner == _msgSender().
lock computes _lockTime from block.timestamp plus user-supplied time.
unlock relies on block.timestamp to decide whether the lock expired.
_transfer uses block.timestamp for swap intervals and randomized buyback limits.
_removeOldSellHistories compares history times against block.timestamp.
_startTimeForSwap is refreshed with block.timestamp.
History retention window depends on block.timestamp.

normalization_plan.reason: The from parameter only exists to drive the _transfer accounting logic.
The to parameter is consumed by _transfer pair/fee branch selection.
The amount parameter is validated and processed entirely inside _transfer.
The recipient parameter flows directly into the raw ETH transfer operation.
The amount parameter is the value passed to the ETH transfer operation.
The new owner parameter is written to state by transferOwnership.
The time parameter only extends the lock timestamp in lock.
The sell tax fee parameter is capped and stored by setSellFee.
The sell liquidity fee parameter is capped and stored by setSellFee.
The account parameter is used solely to toggle reward exclusion.
The tAmount parameter is consumed by deliver accounting.
The token address parameter is used directly in the external transfer call.
The destination parameter is used directly in the external transfer call.
The takeFee local only controls fee removal inside _tokenTransfer.
The local is computed and consumed only for the swap branch in _transfer.
The local balance is derived and consumed only inside _transfer.
The accumulator exists only to size the automatic buyback in _transfer.
The variable is a temporary bound used by the buyback decision in _transfer.
The variable is a temporary bound used by the buyback randomness in _transfer.
